sections.title: About
sections.text: Launchpad Bay is a browser-based music application.

sections.title: Information Processing
sections.text: Depending on the features you use, we process your username, email address, password hash, avatar, GitHub account identifier, friendship connections, and chat messages.

sections.title: About
sections.text: Launchpad Bay is a browser-based launchpad for playing music, with account and social features.

sections.title: Acceptable Use
sections.text: Do not harm other users by spamming, uploading unlawful content, or attempting to disrupt the application.
